reader.requirement: At --std 85, whenever an index-name is the varied operand of a VARYING or of any AFTER phrase of PERFORM format 4, the compiler must refuse a FROM or BY identifier that is not an integer data item (one with no digit positions right of the decimal point, §1985:III.2), a FROM literal that is not a positive integer (0, negative, 1.0, 1.5, ZERO), and a BY literal that is not a nonzero integer, while admitting negative integer BY literals and scaled integer items such as PIC 9P.

edition-consulted.switches: ConstructRegistry numeric-function-identifier-operand-2002: at 85 a numeric/integer function-identifier written as the FROM/BY identifier is refused (COBOL0900, §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR4); 2002+ admits it and SR7a's integer test then applies
DialectBehavior PerformVaryingInitInnerBeforeAugmentOuter selects the run-time augment order (a general rule, not this syntax rule)

reader.edition-search: grep -n 'Edition|DialectLevel|DialectBehavior|ConstructRegistry' ControlFlowBinder.PerformVarying.cs, OperandClassScreen.cs (no edition comparison) and IntrinsicResultType.IsIntegerOperand (none); CheckVaryingOperandRules itself has no edition term
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only for a function-identifier operand: at 85 a numeric/integer function as the FROM/BY identifier is refused by the 1985 placement rule, at 2023 it is admitted and judged by the integer test; every literal and data-item case prints identical diagnostics at 85 and 2023
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb432-varying-operand-rules covers the VARYING-phrase literal and identifier refusals; the AFTER-phrase index-name arm, 1.0 (decimal point with zero fraction), figurative ZERO, the scaled integer PIC 9P FROM operand and the function-identifier operand are not exercised by the witnesses
